_notes: How the App draws the map: real 3D with RealityKit (D-027; 2D retired in D-030). Not game tuning; Core ignores it. outsideMapColor = color around and beyond the map. reality3d: metresPerTile = 1 tile in metres; loadModels = load <artId>.usdz in the background (false = labeled boxes only); placeholderHeightTiles = box height per building category in tiles (box = footprint x height, art id written above it); zombieBoxTiles = zombie box size in tiles; camera = orbit camera (D-029: snapAngles steps, twistThresholdDegrees to turn one step per twist, snapTurnSeconds eased turn; distances and minHeightMetres in metres, minHeightMetres keeps the camera out of roofs; pitch = degrees above the ground; tiltDegreesPerPoint = two-finger up/down drag; pinchSensitivity 1 = follow the fingers exactly, lower = calmer; panMarginTiles = how far past the map edge you can pan; zoom-out also stops when the map fills the screen width); light = dusk sun + fill from the 1R spike (lux, hex colors).
